Subject: Post-demo security kickoff: questionnaire path and evidence owners

Hi Samir / Elena — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on security/compliance items required for procurement.

Recap (short):
- Demo covered inference latency/cost tradeoffs and Redwood Dedicated/Private hosting options.
- CureWell confirmed interest in a scoped POC and needs HIPAA controls for any PHI.

What we need from you to choose the right questionnaire path (SIG vs CAIQ vs small custom):
1) Primary data residency: will production traffic and any stored artifacts be US-only? (regional requirements affect hosting recommendations).
2) Will CureWell transmit or persist PHI to Redwood-managed storage, or will you keep PHI in your environment and only call our hosted inference?
3) Does Procurement require a SOC 2 Type II report and a signed BAA before production rollout?
4) Any mandated evidence format (you mentioned a security portal earlier) or is an attested SIG prefilling acceptable?

Proposed actions / owners:
- Karthik (security) — lead on questionnaire route recommendation + evidence ask list (we can prefll SIG if preferred).
- Grace (CS) — coordinate timeline and schedule a 30-min sync with your security/infra team.
- Marissa (me) — track asks in HubSpot, escalate pricing/contract if legal requires changes.

Suggested timeline: 2–3 weeks to agree on questionnaire route and initial evidence bundle; faster if you can share SOC 2 report and dataflow diagram.

Attachments: SIG_Form_Request_Template.xlsx (short sheet we fill to indicate preferred fields and sample owners).

Could you confirm the answers to Q1–Q4 above and share any existing SOC 2 summary or architecture diagram? Once we have that, Karthik will reply with a minimal evidence checklist and we can decide if SIG prefill is the fastest path.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—

Hi Samir / Marissa — looping in a few technical clarifying points from security so we can size the work and choose SIG vs CAIQ (SIG prefill is often fastest; CAIQ preferred by some infosec teams). A few asks from our side: 

1) Scope of SOC 2: does the SOC 2 cover the whole CureWell service (production infra + third-party integrations) or only your core EHR/data storage components?
2) Data classification: approximate percentage of requests that contain PHI vs non-PHI; if PHI is infrequent we can propose tokenization proxies during the POC.
3) KMS & keys: do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) in KMS/HSM or is Redwood-managed KMS acceptable for the POC?
4) Retention & deletion: expected retention window for any inference logs, debug traces, or cached prompts (we have options for KV cache TTL and opt-out).
5) Network boundary: will you be using VPC peering/private deployment, or will traffic route via public API from your VPC?

If you can share your SOC 2 summary report and a simple dataflow diagram (PDF or a Drive link), that will let me produce a concise evidence matrix (which fields we can prefll on the SIG and which will require doc uploads). For HIPAA: if CureWell will send PHI into Redwood-managed storage we will need a BAA (we can start legal on a standard BAA while Karthik/Grace map controls).

I can start a SIG-prefill template and mark mandatory evidence items; if your team prefers CAIQ we will adapt.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@curewell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@curewell.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security kickoff: questionnaire path and evidence owners

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the clear breakdown. Answers below and attached SOC 2.

Q1) Primary residency: US only (we host in us-east-1 and must keep customer data in the US).
Q2) PHI: yes, CureWell will transmit PHI for certain workflows. We prefer Redwood Dedicated or Private (VPC) for these production flows, but POC can use a scoped test set without PHI.
Q3) SOC 2 + BAA: Procurement will want a SOC 2 Type II report and a signed BAA before production. For POC, a SOC 2 summary + attestation is acceptable.
Q4) Evidence format: Procurement prefers SIG prefilling + direct uploads (they use a vendor portal that imports SIG fields).

Other notes:
- We can provide a basic dataflow diagram (attached) and a short inventory of PHI fields.
- We would prefer Redwood to support customer-managed KMS in production; for the POC Redwood-managed KMS is fine.
- Retention: default retention = 30 days for logs; production retention policy will be defined in contract.

Attachment: CureWell_SOC2_Report_Q4_2025.pdf (redacted), dataflow_diagram_curewell_v1.pdf (attachment stub).

We can do a 30-min technical/security sync on Tues 6/30 or Wed 7/1 — what works?

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform Security | CureWell Health
